instructions:
LRD-preconditioned MCLMC on stoch_vol (503-D AR(1) stochastic volatility).
PARAMETERIZATION: stoch_vol_flatinit_ncp (EXPERIMENTAL — NOT the registered stoch_vol model).
  Flat-init: h[0] = mu + sigma * h_std[0]  (drops sigma/sqrt(1-phi^2) coupling)
  vs registered: h[0] = mu + (sigma/sqrt(1-phi^2)) * h_std[0]  (stationary)
Pipeline: (1) 1000-step flat-init NUTS pilot; (2) rank-30 SVD extraction via extract_lrd_from_samples; (3) mclmc_find_L_and_step_size with make_lrd_kernel binding the LowRankInverseMassMatrix.
IMM checkpoint at inverse_mass_matrix_path; load with np.load to skip re-extraction.
NCP_VARIANT=True → use stoch_vol_flatinit_ncp logdensity.
Warmup uses @jax.vmap over mclmc_find_L_and_step_size (the Python-loop workaround in 3171b49 was solving a phantom bug; reverted in 92f8235).
notes: Multi-seed hardening: seeds [42, 99]. k=30 (not k=50). Flat-init NCP variant reduces phi-h[0] coupling near unit root. Hard-stop R-hat boundary: 1.02. Primary=seed-99 (best honest result: REVIEW). Seed-42 FAIL (rhat=1.169) documents high seed sensitivity. REVIEW is the documented ceiling — see failure_diagnosis.

failure_diagnosis: REVIEW is the documented ceiling for LRD-MCLMC on stoch_vol (503-D AR(1)). Two seeds: seed-99 REVIEW (rhat=1.019, ESS=374), seed-42 FAIL (rhat=1.169, ESS=18). High seed-sensitivity indicates the flat-init NCP variant (h[0]=mu+sigma*h_std[0]) partially reduces the phi-h[0] coupling near the unit root but does NOT eliminate the fundamental difficulty. Root cause: sigma/sqrt(1-phi^2) blowup geometry at phi_con>0.99 creates position-dependent curvature that LRD (a constant O(dk) preconditioner) cannot adapt to at runtime. Further improvement requires per-step adaptive geometry (Riemannian MCLMC) or a prior that rules out phi_con>0.99 entirely. The stationary-init registered model has the same ceiling (see stoch_vol lessons.md). Emitting this recipe as an honest-null record with REVIEW verdict from best seed.
